MoundCanyoning.EnabledDescription:
Enables canyoning of terrain mounds/hills within stream areas.
This is an asymmetrical noise reduction specifically set up to target small mounds that get in the way of rivers.
The terrain sampling on the watershed model helps to avoid most rough terrain and bumps, but rarely some get through so this is used to carve through them.
It carves canyons into the terrain a little bit, but its worth it to prevent streams from being split apart by a mound.
MoundCanyoning.StrengthDescription: Strength of mound canyoning in stream areas.

MoundCanyoningDescription: Configuration for canyoning terrain mounds/hills within stream areas.

LandformCanyoning.EnabledDescription:
Enables canyoning of landform features (hills/mounds) in stream areas.
This is the older landform component of the mound canyoning.
While the more general asymmetric noise canyoning does a better job of carving down mounds, it seems landform noise still gets in the way a little bit.
Haven't touched this much since I got the asymmetric noise canyoning working, it needs another look at some point.
LandformCanyoning.StrengthDescription: Strength of landform canyoning in stream areas.
LandformCanyoning.PowerDescription: Power curve for landform canyoning scaling.
LandformCanyoning.UseExponentialDescription: Use exponential scaling for landform canyoning instead of linear.

LandformCanyoningDescription: Configuration for canyoning down landform hills/mounds in stream areas.

StreambankHeightVariation.EnabledDescription: Enables natural height variation along streambanks via adding extra noise.
StreambankHeightVariation.FactorsAtSourceDescription: Per-octave streambank height variation factors at stream sources.
StreambankHeightVariation.FactorsAtMouthDescription: Per-octave streambank height variation factors at stream mouths.
StreambankHeightVariation.MaxVariationDescription: Maximum streambank height variation for each octave.

StreambankHeightVariationDescription: Configuration for natural height variation along streambanks via adding extra noise.

CanyonRockiness.EnabledDescription: Enables rocky/cliffy variation on canyon walls via adding extra noise.
CanyonRockiness.FactorsAtSourceDescription: Per-octave canyon wall rockiness factors at stream sources.
CanyonRockiness.FactorsAtMouthDescription: Per-octave canyon wall rockiness factors at stream mouths.
CanyonRockiness.MaxRockinessDescription: Maximum canyon wall rockiness for each octave.

CanyonRockinessDescription: Configuration for rocky/cliffy variation on canyon walls via adding extra noise.

StreambedSmoothing.EnabledDescription: Enables smoothing of streambed height transitions.
StreambedSmoothing.LookaheadDistanceDescription: Distance (in curve points) to look ahead when smoothing streambed heights.
StreambedSmoothing.SlopeDepthScalingDescription:
Multiplier that scales how much terrain slope affects streambed depth.
Higher values carve deeper streambeds where the terrain drops.

StreambedSmoothingDescription:
Configuration for smoothing streambed height transitions.
Creates a smooth streambed.

SeaLevelBedDepthCap.TargetBedDepthBelowSeaLevelDescription:
Deepest the carved streambed is allowed to sit below sea level, in blocks.
Stream carving is scaled down just enough that the bed bottoms out at this depth,
so streams of any depth reach the same mouth depth instead of trenching into the sea floor.
Set very high (e.g. 9999) to disable the cap entirely.

SeaLevelBedDepthCapDescription:
Caps how deep streambeds may carve below sea level near stream mouths.
Prevents deep streams from trenching through the sea floor.
